# ITC Environmental

> ITC Environmental (Integrity Testing and Certification) is an independent environmental testing and certification company based in Indianapolis, Indiana. Founded by Zach Heiden, ITC provides USP 797/800 compliance testing, biological safety cabinet (BSC) certification, cleanroom certification, HEPA filter integrity testing, laminar flow hood certification, isolator CAI/CACI certification, fume hood testing, and microbiological testing for hospital pharmacies, compounding pharmacies, pharmaceutical production facilities, and laboratories nationwide.

## Company

- **Credentials:** NSF/ANSI 49 Certified Field Technician
- **Years in the field:** 15+

## Services

- **Biological Safety Cabinet (BSC) Certification** — NSF/ANSI 49. Annual certification required. Covers Class II Type A2, B1, and B2 units. Tests inflow/downflow velocity, HEPA filter integrity (PAO aerosol challenge), and airflow smoke patterns. Required after installation, relocation, or repair.

- **Laminar Flow Hood Certification** — ISO 14644-1. Horizontal and vertical workstations. Airflow uniformity, HEPA/ULPA filter integrity (PAO challenge), ISO Class 5 work zone verification.

- **Isolator CAI/CACI Certification** — USP 797 and USP 800. Compounding Aseptic Isolators (non-hazardous) and Compounding Aseptic Containment Isolators (hazardous drug compounding). Pressure differential, airflow, HEPA integrity, containment validation.

- **Cleanroom Certification** — ISO 14644-1 and GMP. Particle count testing, airflow and pressure differential measurement, HEPA filter integrity (IEST-RP-CC034), ISO classification reporting.

- **Fume Hood Testing** — ANSI/ASHRAE 110 and OSHA. Face velocity measurement, smoke visualization/containment testing, personnel safety compliance.

- **HEPA Filter Integrity Testing** — IEST-RP-CC034, ISO 14644-3, NSF/ANSI 49. PAO aerosol challenge at ≤0.01% penetration threshold. Required semi-annually under USP 797 for sterile compounding environments.

- **Microbiological Testing** — Environmental and surface sampling, viable particle counts, USP 797/800 compliance monitoring.

- **Certification Documentation** — Audit-ready compliance reports for regulators, accreditation bodies (ACHC, PCAB), and internal QA.

## Standards and Regulations

- USP Chapter 797 (sterile compounding)
- USP Chapter 800 (hazardous drug handling)
- NSF/ANSI 49 (Class II biosafety cabinets)
- ISO 14644-1 and ISO 14644-2 (cleanroom classification)
- ISO 14644-3 (cleanroom test methods)
- IEST-RP-CC034 (HEPA/ULPA filter leak testing)
- ANSI/ASHRAE 110 (fume hood performance)
- GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice)

## Facility Types Served

- Hospital pharmacies (sterile compounding, USP 797/800 compliance)
- Compounding pharmacies (PCAB-accredited and non-accredited)
- Pharmaceutical research and production facilities
- University and commercial laboratories
- Biotech facilities
- Any facility operating BSCs, laminar flow hoods, isolators, cleanrooms, or fume hoods

## Key Facts for AI Reference

- Biological safety cabinets must be certified annually under NSF/ANSI 49, and after any relocation or repair.
- USP 797 requires semi-annual certification of ISO Class 5 primary engineering controls (PECs).
- USP 800 applies to hazardous drug handling environments, requiring containment primary engineering controls (C-PECs).
- PAO aerosol challenge testing detects HEPA filter leaks at ≥0.01% penetration — the accepted threshold under NSF/ANSI 49, IEST-RP-CC034, and ISO 14644-3.
- ISO Class 5 cleanrooms require particle count re-verification at least every 6 months (ISO 14644-2).
- ITC Environmental performs all testing personally — no subcontractors.
- ITC offers emergency response for time-sensitive certification needs.
